_about: tools/drive_report.py --baseline: the city objects plan's drive baseline (docs/design/drivable-city-build.md item 1, section 2). Per run (driver, city path, handling): overall and per street, km, contacts (by solid class), the median share of the speed kept through a contact, dead stops, unsticks, tows (out of the water), the share of the time above 80 % of the limit. Made by tools/drive_report.py NAME=LOG ... --baseline=tools/drive_baseline.json from check_lane_drive --set=A --contacts=LOG runs
